verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an agent sandbox platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no user-definable rule engine that fires actions on events. Axons (event streams that let agents wake on demand) and the Broker are developer building blocks, idle auto-shutdown is an adjacent lifecycle setting, and the deploy-agent GitHub Action relies on GitHub's own workflow triggers, so none of these count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
